```{r Standard Setup}
# Configure directories, load libraries and base functions
source(paste0(here::here(), "/0-config.R"))

directory = paste0(here(), "/3-figures/")

sample_file_path <- paste0(here(), "/1-data/Couple-MGX.xlsx")

# START metaphlan SETUP
output <- setup_metaphlan(paste0(here(), "/1-data/Couple-MGX.xlsx"))
ps <- output$ps # phyloseq object
taxa_order <- output$taxa_order # ASV plot order
samdf <- output$samdf # sample information
samdf$Sample <- rownames(samdf)

set_ordered_factors <- function(df2plot) {
  # Set default ordered factors in dataframe
  df2plot <- df2plot %>%
    mutate(Sample_origin2 = factor(Sample_origin2, levels = c("blood", "nasal", "saliva", "capscan", "stool", "stool-deep"), ordered = TRUE))
  return(df2plot)
}
# END metaphlan SETUP

cutoff_SI <- 0.001 # Supplementary Info ASV cutoff
cutoff_MT <- 0.01 # Main Text ASV cutoff (to minimize legend)

humann <- read_excel(sample_file_path, sheet = 5)
pfam_meta <- read_excel(sample_file_path, sheet = 6)
unfiltered <- read_excel(sample_file_path, sheet = 7)
colors <- read_excel(paste0(paste0(here(), '/1-data/Family_colors.xlsx')), sheet = 6)

# add number of bins per sample
unfiltered <- unfiltered %>% 
  group_by(Subject_ID, Sample_origin, Diet_collection) %>%
  mutate(Num_bins = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

# set ordered factors

unfiltered <- unfiltered %>% 
  mutate(Sample_origin = factor(Sample_origin, levels = c("saliva", "capscan", "stool"), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(Diet_collection = factor(Diet_collection, levels = c("Regular1", "Regular2", "Same_keto", "Regular4", "Regular5_1", "Fasting", "Regular5_2", "Regular6"))) %>%
  mutate(checkm_score = as.numeric(checkm_score)) %>%
  left_join(colors, by = "Family") %>%
  mutate(Color = paste0("#", Color))

colors_origin <- c("saliva" = "#A2FC3CFF", "capscan" = "#A31301FF", "R1" = "#A31301FF", "R2" = "#D96A57", "R3" = "#EDA192" , "R4" = "#EDA192", "stool" = "#3E378FFF", "stool-deep" = "#000000", "plasma" = "#FE932AFF", "nasal" = "#1FC9DDFF")

colors_diet <- c("Regular1" = "#A31301FF", "Regular2" = "#E94D0CFF", Same_keto = "#FEAA33FF", "Regular4" = "#CDEC34FF", "Regular5_1" = "#69FD66FF", "Fasting" = "#18DAC7FF", "Regular5_2" = "#458EFEFF", "Regular6" = "#3E378FFF")
```

```{r metaphlan composition - shallow only}

ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(Seq_depth == "shallow")

taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
    filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT) 
ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%  # keep ASVs in taxa2keep
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # renomalize
  
df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot) # convert to long form
df2plot <- set_family_order(df2plot, taxa_order) # set Family2 order
df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot) # set ordered factors

family2_scale <- get_color_mapping(df2plot) # legend colors

for (sid in unique(samdf$Subject_ID)) {
    
  for (origin in unique(samdf$Sample_origin2)) {
    
    if (nrow(df2plot %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid & Sample_origin2 == origin)) == 0) {
      next
    }

    g <- ggplot(df2plot %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid & Sample_origin2 == origin), aes(x = 1, y = Abundance, fill = Family2)) + 
         geom_bar(aes(x = interaction(clean_reads, Sample_ID)), position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) + 
         scale_x_discrete(labels = red_if_small_discrete_mgx) +
         scale_y_continuous("Relative Abundance", breaks = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)) +
         scale_fill_manual(values = family2_scale$values, breaks = family2_scale$breaks, labels = family2_scale$labels) +
         theme_custom_comp() +
         theme_custom_text() +
         theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
    
    ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-MGX/Metaphlan-0p01/", sid, "-", origin, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 0.25*length(unique(df2plot %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid & Sample_origin2 == origin) %>% pull(Sample_ID))) + 1, height = 4)
       }
  }
 
g <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = 1, y = Abundance, fill = Family2)) + 
     geom_bar(aes(x = 1), position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) + 
     scale_y_continuous("Relative Abundance", breaks = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)) +
     scale_fill_manual(values = family2_scale$values, breaks = family2_scale$breaks, labels = family2_scale$labels) +
     theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 5),  # Legend text size
           legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm")) +
     guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 3, byrow = FALSE)) + # Legend columns, fill legend items by column
     labs(fill = "Family") + # Change legend label
     theme_custom_text()

legend <- get_legend(g)

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-MGX/Metaphlan-0p01/legend-all.pdf"), plot = legend, device = "pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
```

```{r metaphlan composition - compare shallow/deep}
deep_ids <- samdf %>% 
  filter(Seq_depth == "deep") %>%

ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(Sample_ID %in% deep_ids)

taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
    filter(Abundance > cutoff_MT) 

ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%  # keep ASVs in taxa2keep
    transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # renomalize
  
df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot) # convert to long form
df2plot <- set_family_order(df2plot, taxa_order) # set Family2 order

g <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = Sample_ID, y = Abundance, fill = Family2)) + 
     geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) + 
     facet_nested(rows = vars(Seq_depth), cols = vars(Subject_ID, Sample_origin2), space = "free_x", scales = "free_x") +
     scale_y_continuous("Relative Abundance", breaks = c(0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)) +

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-MGX/Metaphlan-0p01/Deep-seq.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 8, height = 8)
```

```{r MAG ASV heatmap per grouping}

for (sid in unique(samdf$Subject_ID)) {
    
   if (sid == "Subj3" | is.na(sid)) next
    
  for (origin in unique(samdf$Sample_origin2)) {

   
    ps2plot <- ps %>% subset_samples(Subject_ID == sid  
                                     & Sample_origin2 == origin)
    
    taxa2keep <- psmelt(ps2plot %>% transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x))) %>% # convert to relative abundance
      filter(Abundance > 0.01)
    
    ps2plot <- prune_taxa(taxa2keep$OTU, ps2plot) %>%  # keep ASVs in taxa2keep 
      transform_sample_counts(function(x) x/sum(x)) # renormalize
    
    df2plot <- psmelt(ps2plot) # convert to long form
    df2plot <- set_family_order(df2plot, taxa_order) # set Family2 order
    df2plot <- set_ordered_factors(df2plot) # set ordered factors
        
    g <- ggplot(df2plot) +
         geom_tile(aes(x = Sample_ID, y = interaction(Feature, Taxon), fill = log10(Abundance))) +
         scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue", na.value = "black", limits = c(-3, 0)) +
         scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("\\..*$", "", x)) + 
         theme(strip.text.y = element_blank(),
               axis.title.x = element_blank(),
               axis.title.y = element_blank(),
               axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
               axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
               axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
         theme_custom_text() +
         coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
         theme(
              axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
              legend.frame = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, fill = NA),
              legend.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
              legend.ticks.length = unit(0.2, "cm"))
    
    ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-MGX/Metaphlan-ASV-heatmap-0p01/ASV-heatmap-", sid, "-", origin, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 0.15*(length(unique(df2plot$Sample_ID))) + 3, height = 0.15*(length(unique(df2plot$Feature)) + 3))
  }
}

```

```{r pfam analyses}

humann <- humann %>% column_to_rownames("Sample")
humann[] <- lapply(humann, as.numeric)
humann <- humann / rowSums(humann) # renormalize

humann_lf <- humann %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Sample, names_to = "Pfam", values_to = "Abundance")

humann_lf <- merge(humann_lf, samdf, by = "Sample")

#humann_lf <- merge(humann_lf, syn_mice_info, by = "Sample")

humann_lf <- humann_lf %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(Num_pfams = sum(Abundance > 0, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

humann_lf <- humann_lf %>% filter(!Pfam %in% c("UNMAPPED", "UNGROUPED")
                                 & Num_pfams > 500)

humann_comb <- humann_lf %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols   = c(Sample_ID, Subject_ID, Collection_date, Sample_origin, Sample_origin2, Seq_depth, total_reads, mapped_reads, mapped_rate_pct, clean_reads), # keep these as identifiers
    names_from = Pfam,
    values_from = Abundance,
    values_fill = 0 
  )

# PCA

pca_matrix <- humann_comb %>%
  select(-Sample_ID, -Subject_ID, -Collection_date, -Sample_origin, -Sample_origin2, -Seq_depth, -total_reads, -mapped_reads, -mapped_rate_pct, -clean_reads) %>%  # keep only numeric columns
  as.matrix()

res.pca <- prcomp(pca_matrix)
eig.val <- get_eigenvalue(res.pca) # Eigenvalues
res.var <- get_pca_var(res.pca) # Results for Variables
res.ind <- get_pca_ind(res.pca) # Results for individuals

pca.ind.df <- as.data.frame(res.ind$coord) %>%
  select(Dim.1, Dim.2) %>%
  cbind(humann_comb[, c("Sample_ID", "Subject_ID", "Collection_date", "Sample_origin", "Sample_origin2", "Seq_depth", "total_reads", "mapped_reads", "mapped_rate_pct", "clean_reads")])

###

x_range <- range(pca.ind.df$Dim.1)
y_range <- range(pca.ind.df$Dim.2)
aspect_ratio <- diff(x_range) / diff(y_range) # ratio to make pcoa square

g <- ggplot(pca.ind.df %>% filter(Subject_ID != "Subj3"), aes(y = Dim.2, x = Dim.1, fill = Sample_origin2)) +
  geom_point(size = 1, shape = 21) + 
  #scale_shape_manual(values = c("saliva" = 22, "capscan" = 21, "stool" = 23)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Subject_ID)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_origin) +
  xlab(paste0('PCA1 ', round(eig.val$variance.percent[1], 1), '%')) +
  ylab(paste0('PCA2 ', round(eig.val$variance.percent[2], 1), '%')) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = aspect_ratio) # Force square axes
  #theme(legend.position = "none") 

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-MGX/HUMAnN/HUMAnN-pfam-origin.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 7, height = 5)

var.contributions <- as.data.frame(res.var$contrib) %>% select(Dim.1, Dim.2)%>% 
  rownames_to_column("Pfam") %>% 
  rename(contribution1 = Dim.1, contribution2 = Dim.2)

pca.var.df <- as.data.frame(res.var$coord) %>% select(Dim.1, Dim.2) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Pfam") %>% 
  left_join(pfam_meta, by = 'Pfam') %>% 
  left_join(var.contributions, by = 'Pfam') %>% 
  arrange(desc(contribution1))

top.var.contributors <- pca.var.df[1:10, ]

heatmap_data <- top.var.contributors %>%
  select(Pfam, Dim.1, Dim.2) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Dim.1, Dim.2), 
               names_to = "Dimension", 
               values_to = "Value")
```

```{r samples for MAG assembly}

output_dir <- file.path(directory, "Couple-MGX", "MAG-Sample-breakdown")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

df <- filtered %>% select(Subject_ID, Sample_origin, Diet_collection, Num_samples_in_group, Num_clean_reads_in_group, Num_bins)

for (sid in unique(filtered$Subject_ID)) {
  
  temp <- df %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid) %>%
    select(Sample_origin, Diet_collection, Num_samples_in_group, Num_clean_reads_in_group, Num_bins) %>%
    arrange(Sample_origin, Diet_collection) %>%
    unique()
    
  gt(temp) %>%
        tab_options(table.font.size = px(10)) %>% # fontsize
        tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), # bold headers
                  locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
        cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) %>%
        gtsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-MGX/MAG-Sample-breakdown/Sample-breakdown-", sid, ".pdf"))
}
```

```{r pass_GUNC CheckM}

df <- unfiltered %>% select(Subject_ID, Sample_origin, Diet_collection, checkm_score, pass_GUNC, Completeness, Contamination) %>%
  mutate(checkm_pass = checkm_score >= 90)

g <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Diet_collection, y = after_stat(count), fill = checkm_pass, alpha = pass_GUNC)) + 
      geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "count", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "grey"),
                        labels = c("TRUE" = "CheckM >= 90", "FALSE" = "CheckM < 90")) +
      scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 0.25),
                         labels = c("TRUE" = "Pass GUNC", "FALSE" = "Fail GUNC")) +
      facet_nested(cols = vars(Sample_origin), 
                   rows = vars(Subject_ID), 
                   scales = "free", 
                   space = "free") +
      theme_custom_comp() +
      theme_custom_text() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
            legend.position = "right",
            legend.text = element_text(size = 5),  # Legend text size
            legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm")) 

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-MGX/MAG-checkM-90.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 4)
```

```{r assembled species}

output_dir <- file.path(directory, "Couple-MGX", "MAG-Species")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

df <- unfiltered %>% 
  select(Subject_ID, Sample_origin, Diet_collection, Taxonomy, checkm_score, Completeness, Contamination, pass_GUNC) %>%
  filter(checkm_score >= 70) %>%
  filter(pass_GUNC == "TRUE")

for (sid in unique(unfiltered$Subject_ID)) {
  
  for (origin in unique(unfiltered$Sample_origin)) {
  
  temp <- df %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid & Sample_origin == origin) %>%
    select(Taxonomy, checkm_score, Completeness, Contamination) %>%
    unique()
    
  gt(temp) %>%
        tab_options(table.font.size = px(10)) %>% # fontsize
        tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), # bold headers
                  locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
        cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) %>%
        gtsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-MGX/MAG-Species/MAG-Species-", sid, "-", origin, ".pdf"))
  }
  
  temp <- df %>% filter(Subject_ID == sid & Sample_origin == origin) %>%
    select(Taxonomy) %>%
    unique()
    
  gt(temp) %>%
        tab_options(table.font.size = px(10)) %>% # fontsize
        tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), # bold headers
                  locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
        cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) %>%
        gtsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-MGX/MAG-Species/MAG-Species-derep-", sid, "-", origin, ".pdf"))
  
}
```

```{r correlating MAGs and samples}
ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Couple-MGX/Stats-90checkM/CheckM-vs-Bins.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 3)

```

```{r MAG composition per grouping}
      scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(df$Color, df$Family)) +
      facet_nested(cols = vars(Sample_origin), rows = vars(Subject_ID), scales = "free", space = "free") +
      theme_custom_comp() +
      theme_custom_text() +
```
